notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheet's two edge figures are the edge strip (ground colour) and edge + black border, as the AS 1743 drawings. Sheet W5-SA63 (for use north of the dog fence, otherwise W5-38): W5-SA63B illustrated (A 600, C 900; PNG W5-SA63A.png). Diamond 750 side, drawn in its 1060.66 bounding square (centre 530.33); yellow, R50, 10 / 30 (edge 10 + border 20). Symbol: cow, 'WS 122' (615 x 385) — taken from the sheet's own filled artwork (PDF fills rendered at 1000 dpi without the dimension and centre lines, traced), ink box x 236-850, y 355-740 as drawn on the sign.
